Vitamin D and respiratory bacterial infections
A large number of studies have associated a deﬁcit of vitamin D blood levels and increased risk and severity of acute respiratory
infections in children, adolescents and adults. Randomized controlled trials exploring the potential of vitamin D to prevent acute
